## About

Afnan Javed is a founder and product builder based in Pakistan. He has been building projects since 4th grade. His work focuses on understanding business needs, shaping product ideas, planning useful workflows, testing software, and improving how people manage everyday work.

His portfolio includes Dinaaro, a retail management software product, and selected projects created for organizations. His work is not limited to one product or industry.

## Product

### Dinaaro
Website: https://dinaaro.com/
Creator: Afnan Javed
Category: Retail management software

Dinaaro brings sales, inventory, customer accounts, supplier records, and daily retail operations into one system. It began as software for Afnan's own shop and developed through use in day to day operations. The product focuses on practical retail workflows and ease of use, with the needs of businesses in Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in mind.

Reported operating milestones:
- More than PKR 1 million in transaction value processed
- Used in 2 retail shops
- More than 1 year of operational experience

These are product usage milestones. Transaction value is not revenue, and the shop count is not a count of independent SaaS customers.

## Selected client projects

### School management system
A custom system for a school, covering online student attendance, staff attendance, student records, fee records and vouchers, substitute teacher arrangements, and student performance records. The public portfolio uses the working label “Oxford Grammar / Cambridge Edtech School” pending confirmation of the exact client and certificate name.

### Switch Power Co.
A website project for an electrical and lighting business in Saudi Arabia. The site helps visitors explore the company and its products.
Website: https://switchpowersa.com/

### Nexus Tech PK
An online storefront for digital products and subscriptions, including custom subscription tracking and renewal reminders.
Website: https://nexustech.pk/

## Vision

Afnan wants to build useful technology that helps businesses and organizations reduce unnecessary manual work, manage information more clearly, and make better decisions. Retail is one current area of work, not the limit of his future interests.
